description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractPolicyMappingStrategies' which provides helper methods for mapping 'Adaptable' objects to policy-related commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to extract policy IDs, policies, policy entries, resources, labels, subjects, and other policy components from given adaptables and their payloads.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class providing static helper methods for mapping adaptables to policy command objects, such as policies, policy entries, resources, subjects, etc.

methods.name: policyIdFromTopicPath
methods.description: Extracts a PolicyId object from a given TopicPath.

methods.name: policyFrom
methods.description: Creates a Policy object from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: policyEntryFrom
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntry object from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: policyEntriesFrom
methods.description: Creates an Iterable of PolicyEntry objects from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: resourceFrom
methods.description: Creates a Resource object from an Adaptable.

methods.name: resourcesFrom
methods.description: Creates a Resources object from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: labelFrom
methods.description: Extracts a Label object from an Adaptable's payload path.

methods.name: entryResourceKeyFromPath
methods.description: Extracts a ResourceKey from a MessagePath assuming certain path structure.

methods.name: entrySubjectIdFromPath
methods.description: Extracts a SubjectId from a MessagePath assuming certain path structure.

methods.name: subjectFrom
methods.description: Creates a Subject object from an Adaptable.

methods.name: subjectsFrom
methods.description: Creates a Subjects object from an Adaptable.
